headlines.title: Leading CHROs and Business Executives to Convene at i4cp's 2027 Next Practices Now Conference
headlines.summary: Continuing the tradition of the industry's top human capital conference, some of the world's most influential companies and progressive thought leaders will gather at the 2027 i4cp Next Practices Now Conference next March 23-25, 2027 at the Fairmont Scottsdale. They will glean insights from a distinguished lineup of CHROs and senior executives from organizations including Optum, Accenture, Microsoft, Lowe's, ServiceNow, Databricks, and Levi Strauss & Co.

headlines.title: Mortgage Rates Have Jumped More Than 1 Point Since February. Home Depot and Lowe’s Shareholders Are Feeling the Pain.
headlines.summary: While these are quality businesses, their shares have drastically underperformed the market in the past three years.

headlines.title: Why BJ’s Wholesale Club and Lowe’s invest windfalls in their customers
headlines.summary: Both retailers received large cash windfalls in their latest quarters, and both put that money to work for customers with investments in loyalty, promotions and other related initiatives.

headlines.title: Trump’s Tariff Refund Saved Lowe’s From An Earnings Miss. Here’s The Math On How Government Tariff Refunds Are Padding Retailers’ Profits
headlines.summary: Lowe's cleared Wall Street's bar last quarter, but one line in the release tells a different story. Court-ordered tariff refunds are flowing to retailers, not shoppers, and each company is spending the windfall differently.

headlines.title: Lowe's Mylow Assistant Strengthens Its Online Shopping Experience
headlines.summary: LOW's digital sales gain momentum as its Mylow AI assistant boosts conversion, while better fulfillment and wider product selection support online growth.

description: Lowe's Companies, Inc., together with its subsidiaries, operates as a home improvement retailer in the United States and Canada. It provides a line of products for construction, maintenance, repair, remodeling, and decorating. The company also offers home improvement products, such as appliances, seasonal and outdoor living, lumber, lawn and garden, kitchens and bath, hardware, building materials, millwork, paint, rough plumbing, tools, electrical, flooring, and décor. In addition, it provides installation services through independent contractors in various product categories; and extended protection plans and repair services. Further, the company provides design, distribution, and installation services for interior surface finishes to home builders and property managers. It sells its national brand-name merchandise and private brand products to professional customers, individual homeowners, and renters. The company serves its products through Lowes.com website, mobile applications, retail home improvement stores and outlet stores, and its branches. Lowe's Companies, Inc. was founded in 1921 and is based in Mooresville, North Carolina.
